specificFindings: Calhoun recalls her parents views on freedom and security;this is attributed advice,not a universal law or experimental finding. The authors freedom/possibility/challenge contrasts remain his position rather than an instruction to ignore individual risks.

The generalist entry first describes a highly specialised world and later acknowledges specialisation often leads to professional success. The question does not turn a warning about excessive specialisation into a claim that it never succeeds.

Take a Dozen names pigeons and humans. Sitting quietly on our commute continues across pages167-168;the full inherited parent and exact quotation preserve the list and its antecedent. Exploring more is the authors general claim,not a guaranteed improvement for every decision.
The familiar entry says psychological richness can also be found in familiar things. It does not claim all familiar experiences are rich or that all people must prefer novelty.

Negative events may happen and the author encourages reflection. Nietzsche and Joyce references are literary/philosophical encouragement,not controlled trials or promises that every hardship inevitably produces growth. Negative emotions are not treated as a diagnosis.

Write and Tell identifies the accumulation of interesting stories. Editing a story does not mean inventing facts;springboard for growth is a metaphor,not a universal psychological outcome. Hemingway is the author of the referenced moveable feast expression.

The spontaneous entry describes a highly scheduled time and most people needing appointments to see friends,not a universal absolute. The Stop by a / gallery... candidates form one complete cross-page sentence;the question references the three actual examples and retains exact source wording.

Six list-number markers are each grouped with their immediately following substantive heading/sentence into one content question. They are structural IDs,not independent sentences. A seventh group joins two cross-page fragments of one sentence. Consequently18 individually authored questions cover25 frozen candidate IDs without seven redundant mechanical questions.

All 12 full inherited English/Chinese parent pairs and all18 questions,option translations,individual analyses,vocabulary and examples were reviewed against actual PDF167-169. The grouping validator requires adjacency and a shared reading unit;each quote contains both grouped IDs and the planned-ID guard rejects unassigned gaps. Published fingerprints and historical answers are unchanged.
